reviews.review:
This is a fantastic action game that displays some of the best use of the Warhammer 40K IP yet. The combat is raw and thrilling; all the guns feel fantastic and the melee combat, although seemingly shallow on the surface, does have it's own nuances to it that provide an adequate challenge whilst being completely satisfying. Transition from melee and ranged combat is seamless, and all battles are fun to fight. I had loads of fun tearing apart hordes of Orks.

Any third-person action fan or 40K fan in general should pick up this game. I found the PC controls to be better suited for this game. This new series has huge potential and I hope we see a sequel, one day, despite THQ's collapse.
Kill the mutant. Burn the heretic. Purge the unclean. Your success is measured in blood. Now strike, in the name of the Emperor.

reviews.review:
Fairly short, I got 12 hours out of it on hard, but pretty darn fun. It's controls feel weighty and satisfying, as do its guns, and the game does a great job making you feel like one of the Emperor's finest. It also does a great job capturing the scale of things in the 40k universe, which really impressed me. 

Biggest downside is the writing. It's probably the worst I've seen in a game. The conversations are basically trading just one-liners for the first 2/3rds of the game, and the characterization on the marines is just god-awful. But shoot, you're not playing this for the story, you're playing it to be a Space Marine!

Went and got this Game after watching Total Biscuit's Review, I have had previous experience with WH40K, both games and tabletop, have to say i Love this game.

Totally gets you in the idea of the Space Marines.

Just wish there was more games with other chapters of Space Marine to play (that are as good as this one)
